content: Human-labeling session — def-reinforce-the-breach:hard seed 1. Objective: Two-lane defence — north (y≈12) and south (y≈28) with two-tank garrisons — plus a four-tank reserve at a seed-chosen central column. Both lanes face a light probe; mid-episode one lane is breached by a heavier wave. Keep at least four tanks alive and have at least four of them inside the breached lane's forward intercept disc at the deadline, within about 22 turns (tight).
